meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 直接从宿主机的 .env 文件中读取 Anthropic 凭证（API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌），不再经过 OneCLI 网关。它把这些凭证注入到容器环境里，让 Claude Agent SDK 原生使用它们。
howto.when: 当你在 .env 文件中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 并提供了有效的凭证时触发。启动容器后，Claude 就会使用这些凭证连接 Anthropic API。

say.text: 请从 .env 文件读取我的 Claude 订阅凭证并连接。
使用我的 Anthropic API 密钥进行连接。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude reads Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token) from the host's .env file and injects them into the container environment, bypassing the OneCLI gateway. The Claude Agent SDK then uses these credentials natively.
howto.when_en: Triggered when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env along with a valid credential (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, etc.). After a restart, the container uses the credentials from .env.

say_en.text: Read my Claude subscription credentials from .env and connect.
say_en.note: Make sure you have CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in .env.

say_en.text: Use my Anthropic API key for connection.
say_en.note: Make sure you have ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.
